name: The Ghost in My Apartment
source:
So like...hear me out: you're a sad office slave with a serious sleep deprivation and constant overtime at work, until one day someone barges into your apartment and... cleans it. Washes your dirty socks. Throws your trash away. Leaves you a sandwich. And disappears.

What will you do? Call the police orrrrr...?

[From [url=https://mousebeanray.itch.io/theghostinmyapartment]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
就像……听我说完：你是一个悲伤的办公室奴隶，严重睡眠不足，经常加班，直到有一天有人闯入你的公寓并……打扫它。洗你的脏袜子。把你的垃圾扔掉。给你留下一个三明治。然后消失。

你会怎么做？报警还是……？

[来自[url=https://mousebeanray.itch.io/theghostinmyapartment]itch.io[/url]]
